description: Export Ledger Download File V3. Part of the File APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

withInvoice.description: With invoice query parameter. Default: false. Optional.

type.description: Voucher or entity type discriminator for the list. Default: view-detailed. Optional.

format.description: Response or export format. Default: excel. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc. Optional.

fileType.description: Output file type. Default: base64. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

accountCurrency.description: Account currency query parameter. Default: true. Optional.
